The '''''Luxurious''-class space yacht''' was a model of [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]. Ghtroc's single entry into the luxury yacht market, each ''Luxurious''-class was custom, hand-built to owners' specifications. Buyers were offered a dizzying array of options to choose from, ranging from ship's power systems to the fixtures in the captain's head. Quirkily charming, a trait common to Ghtroc products, the yachts were among the fastest and most finely appointed in the galaxy in their heyday.<ref name="Far Horizons" />

No two ''Luxurious''-class were alike. However, they did share superficial similarities, such as relatively short, broad in the beam hulls and a top-down profile that resembled an oversized [[BTL_Y-wing_starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]]. The front half of the central hull was a half-domed, four-decked, transparisteel fronted section. The command deck and bridge, staterooms, common area, and observation deck were housed inside it. A spartan, utilitarian section abaft of the passenger decks contained engineering and crew accommodations. Powerful engines were located in sleek port and starboard sponsons, providing the vessel its incredible speed.<ref name="Far Horizons" />
